head.description: Artistic Confections, Tallahassee FL: custom wedding cakes, cupcakes and pastries by owner Maria Streety. Gluten-free and vegan options available. 5.0 stars, 25 reviews on WeddingWire. Call (850) 577-3000.
head.og_description: 5.0 stars on WeddingWire. Custom wedding cakes, cupcakes and pastries, made to order.

jsonld.name: Artistic Confections
jsonld.description: Custom wedding cake studio in Tallahassee, FL, led by owner Maria Streety: wedding cakes, cupcakes and pastries, including gluten-free and vegan options.

script.es: Cada pastel, una obra de arte.
script.en: Every cake, a work of art.

parrafo.es: Liderada por su dueña, Maria Streety, Artistic Confections diseña pasteles de boda, cupcakes y repostería personalizada desde Tallahassee. Cada pedido, incluidos los pasteles sin gluten y veganos, se hace de forma individual para que quede tal como lo pediste.
parrafo.en: Led by owner Maria Streety, Artistic Confections designs custom wedding cakes, cupcakes and pastries out of Tallahassee. Every order, gluten-free and vegan cakes included, is made individually to match exactly what you asked for.

hero.imagen_alt: Outdoor wedding dessert table with a white tiered cake by Artistic Confections, flanked by crystal candelabras under an oak tree

parrafo_1.es: Artistic Confections es un negocio liderado por su dueña, Maria Streety, con licencia del departamento de salud del estado. Diseña pasteles de boda, cupcakes y pasteles de celebración a medida para clientes en Tallahassee.
parrafo_1.en: Artistic Confections is a woman-owned business led by Maria Streety and licensed by the state health department. It designs custom wedding cakes, cupcakes and celebration cakes for clients around Tallahassee.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientas en WeddingWire destacan la atención directa de Maria, los planes de pago flexibles y pasteles sin gluten o veganos que no sacrifican el sabor.
parrafo_2.en: Her WeddingWire reviewers point to Maria's direct attention, flexible payment plans, and gluten-free or vegan cakes that do not sacrifice flavor.

nosotros.imagen_1_alt: Five-tier wedding cake with cascading pink and white flowers under string lights at an outdoor reception
nosotros.imagen_2_alt: Five-tier fondant wedding cake with pearl detail and monogram topper by Artistic Confections
nosotros.avatar_alt: Detail of a buttercream wedding cake with a sugar rose by Artistic Confections

texto.es: Nos cuentas la fecha, el evento y lo que imaginas, y conversamos por teléfono o mensaje.
texto.en: Tell us the date, the event and what you have in mind, and we talk it through by phone or message.

texto.es: Elegimos juntos el diseño, el sabor y si necesitas opciones sin gluten o veganas.
texto.en: We work out the design and flavor together, including gluten-free or vegan options if you need them.

texto.es: Tu pastel se hornea y decora a mano de forma individual, tal como lo pediste.
texto.en: Your cake is baked and decorated by hand, made individually to match what you asked for.

texto.es: Coordinamos la entrega o el retiro para que tu pastel llegue a tiempo.
texto.en: We coordinate pickup or delivery so your cake is ready in time for your event.

nota.es: Cada pastel personalizado se cotiza según el tamaño, sabor y diseño. Escríbenos y te lo explicamos con gusto.
nota.en: Every custom cake is quoted based on size, flavor and design. Message us and we will walk you through it.

texto.es: Pasteles de boda de varios pisos en buttercream o fondant, diseñados según tus colores y tu estilo.
texto.en: Custom tiered wedding cakes in buttercream or fondant, designed around your colors and your style.

texto.es: Cumpleaños, graduaciones y pasteles temáticos hechos a pedido, desde los clásicos hasta diseños totalmente escultóricos.
texto.en: Birthdays, graduations and theme cakes made to order, from classic designs to fully sculpted creations.

texto.es: Cupcakes horneados frescos a pedido, perfectos para fiestas, mesas de postres o como complemento de un pastel.
texto.en: Cupcakes baked fresh to order, perfect for parties, dessert tables, or as an add-on to any cake.

texto.es: Pasteles sin gluten y veganos sin sacrificar el sabor, confirmados por clientas reales en sus reseñas.
texto.en: Gluten-free and vegan cakes made without sacrificing flavor, confirmed by real client reviews.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Escríbenos igual, lo cotizamos.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Message us anyway, we will quote it.

items.quote: Perfect experience! She listened, made suggestions, had affordable payment plans, and the taste was great. Not one slice was left.
I have a gluten allergy and the whole cake was made gluten free - guests couldn't tell the difference.
A true professional - great flavor and reasonable prices. Best Cake Ever!
